title: Codex Cumanicus complete aligned inflection tables in three Latin-script languages
summary: RAW_SOURCE_SUPPORTED, NOT SELECTED. Native Kuun1880 printed p1 supplies a complete six-person present paradigm aligned across Latin, Persian and Cuman, followed by a complete imperfect table. Fixed row/column order and repeated spelling parts offer a joint grammatical copy contract distinct from disjoint synonym triples or arbitrary paragraph-language choice. No target access or decoder.

design.source: Geza Kuun, Codex Cumanicus, Budapest1880; University of Toronto scan https://archive.org/details/codexcumanicusbi00kuunuoft/page/n148/mode/1up . Complete PDF https://archive.org/download/codexcumanicusbi00kuunuoft/codexcumanicusbi00kuunuoft.pdf SHA256 78be07bc3ebd06f683a6b06501fe38a2fb7f660fb77c9f25845a1035a62e09f9. Native printed pp1-4 viewed (PDF149-152). Printed opening dates itself MCCCIII die XI Iuly; this is an edition of manuscript text, not our original-manuscript collation.
design.observed_table: Printed p1 has three aligned columns. Six present rows: audio/mesnoem/eziturmen; audis/mesnoy/esitursen; audit/mesnoet/esitur; audimus/mesnam/esiturbis; auditis/mesnoyt/esitursis; audiunt(with abbreviation mark in edition)/mesnoent/esiturlar. Singular three and plural three are explicitly separated. Do not normalize ezitur to esitur or mesnam to an inferred regular form. Complete six-person imperfect follows under its own heading.
design.mechanism: A future conditional model could require an entire ordered six-by-three table, or a predeclared complete family of such tables, with one global literal-script channel and fixed cell serialization. Exact aligned forms bind person/number correspondences across languages while repeated substrings constrain shared code values. Source column order is fixed; any unknown target traversal must be a finite preregistered whole-table choice, never arbitrary row permutation or language choice per cell. This is a source-supported mechanism, not yet a target copy law.
design.scope_limits: Full audio conjugation continues over later pages; printed p4 has blank Persian/Cuman cells in the pluperfect subjunctive and future section. Therefore do not call the entire audio conjugation a complete trilingual rectangular table. pp1-4 also contain deleted letters, expanded abbreviations, sic marks, added readings and shorthand y/c/z; these must remain explicit. No claim that native manuscript layout matches all editorial alignment decisions.
design.novelty: Unlike IDEA122 generic shared-script prose, the observed source fixes aligned grammatical cells and ordered subject positions. Unlike Alphita/Simon head-mention graphs, repeated inflection spellings impose literal global equations. This does not establish identifiability: no opaque cell IDs, and all fitting keys/traversals/source tables must be projected before assigning meanings.
design.next_decision: GO only for bounded independent source collation and target-contract assessment if selected; no experiment selected here. Determine complete table inventory, diplomatic typography policy, and an already admitted complete target unit capable of representing all cells without omissions. A source table alone does not establish a Voynich table or a historical cipher channel. No automatic fit on six convenient words; no repaired missing cells.
design.exposure: No Voynich data queried or images opened in this task; earlier target exposure persists.
